title: smime-tree verify.rs: verify_sig dispatch uses if/else chain on OID constants — match would be clearer
description: verify.rs verify_sig() and cert.rs verify_signature() use chains of if *oid == SHA_256_WITH_RSA_ENCRYPTION { } else if *oid == SHA_384... { } ... This is the only option because ObjectIdentifier const patterns don't work in match arms — but the code looks like a smell to reviewers. Idiomatic fix: encapsulate the dispatch in a macro or document why match cannot be used here. A comment explaining why if/else is required would prevent contributors from repeatedly trying to convert this to a match.
